name: ybial-agents
description: AI agent layer for Your Business in a Link

scripts.deploy:onboarding: gcloud functions deploy ybial-onboarding-webhook --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --entry-point onboardingWebhook --source dist
scripts.deploy:support: gcloud functions deploy ybial-support-chat --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --entry-point supportChat --source dist
scripts.deploy:churn: gcloud functions deploy ybial-churn-nightly --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --entry-point churnNightly --source dist
scripts.deploy:advisor: gcloud functions deploy ybial-advisor-weekly --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --entry-point advisorWeekly --source dist
scripts.deploy:booking-chat: gcloud functions deploy ybial-booking-chat --runtime nodejs20 --trigger-http --entry-point bookingChatEndpoint --source dist
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && npm run deploy:onboarding && npm run deploy:support && npm run deploy:churn && npm run deploy:advisor && npm run deploy:booking-chat
